sermon.title: Martha Rejects Jesus’ Plans Because of Past Science—February 07, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer shows Martha objecting when Jesus said “take away the stone,” relying on what she knew instead of His promise. God’s glory will fill the earth, and much remains before Christ’s return. Like the apostles, the church must pray for boldness and miracles and be shaken and filled with the Holy Ghost.
